'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Jerry Heine DS Invasion''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jerry Heine]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Invasion / In Complete Control]]
* '''Username:''' quesosauce37
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
